secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key (console.anthropic.com → API Keys). Powers the interview question streaming and book synthesis. Without it the landing page still renders but the interview/synthesis features won't work.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com → API Keys). Powers Hebrew speech-to-text (gpt-4o-transcribe) for the optional voice dictation in the interview. Without it the mic appears but transcription returns a 'type instead' message.
